contact_properties.description: Properties defining the state of the contact associated to this event. Useful to update contact attributes defined in your contacts database while passing the event. For example: **"FIRSTNAME": "Jane" , "AGE": 37**

event_date.description: Timestamp of when the event occurred (e.g. "2024-01-24T17:39:57+01:00"). If no value is passed, the timestamp of the event creation is used.

event_name.description: The name of the event that occurred. This is how you will find your event in Brevo. Limited to 255 characters, alphanumerical characters and - _ only.

event_properties.description: Properties of the event. Top level properties and nested properties can be used to better segment contacts and personalise workflow conditions. The following field type are supported: string, number, boolean (true/false), date (Timestamp e.g. "2024-01-24T17:39:57+01:00"). Keys are limited to 255 characters, alphanumerical characters and - _ only. Size is limited to 50Kb.

identifiers.description: Identifies the contact associated with the event. At least one identifier is required.

object.description: Identifiers of the object record associated with this event. Ignored if the object type or identifier for this record does not exist on the account.

contact_id.description: Internal unique contact ID. When present, this takes priority over all other identifiers for event attribution and contact resolution.

email_id.description: Email Id associated with the event
